name: jst-ph-s8b-sm4
description: JST S8B-PH-SM4-TB(LF)(SN) PH 2.0 mm side-entry SMD header, 8 pins, 2 A / 100 V per pin, mates with PHR-8 housings. LCSC C265121 (extended)

pins.name: MP
pins.description: mounting tabs (mechanical; leave unconnected or tie to GND)

metadata.rotation_note: Footprint has pin 1 at -x and the cable entering from +y, the pin-pad side (verified on JLCPCB's 3D preview on the mug order, 2026-09-08, offset 0: the model matches the pads). To point the mouth at a board edge on the +x side, place at rotation 270; pin 1 then sits at the +y end.
